faqs.q: What is the cashback rate offered by HSBC Live+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: HSBC Live+ Credit Card offers 10% cashback on eligible food, dining, grocery, shopping and utility bill payments, up to Rs. 1,200 per month. It also offers unlimited 1.5% cashback on other eligible spends.

faqs.q: What is the maximum cashback I can earn on HSBC Live+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn up to Rs. 1,200 cashback per month on the eligible 10% cashback categories. In addition, you can earn unlimited 1.5% cashback on other eligible spends.

faqs.q: Does HSBC Live+ Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes. The card offers up to 2 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per year, with a maximum of 1 visit in six months. It also offers 1 complimentary international airport lounge visit every year.

faqs.q: Does HSBC Live+ Credit Card offer movie discounts?
faqs.a: Yes. Cardholders can avail Buy 1 Get 1 offers on movie and live event tickets through District and BookMyShow as per the applicable terms and conditions.

faqs.q: Is HSBC Live+ Credit Card suitable for international travel?
faqs.a: It can be a suitable option for international travellers as it offers a 1.99% forex markup fee, 1 complimentary international airport lounge visit annually and a complimentary 1GB Global eSIM with discounted top-ups.

faqs.question: Is the HSBC Live+ Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: The HSBC Live+ Credit Card is a good choice if you spend regularly on groceries, dining, food delivery, shopping and utility bills. These categories earn 10% cashback, making it one of the best cashback credit cards for everyday spending.

faqs.question: What is the cashback limit on the HSBC Live+ Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers 10% cashback on eligible grocery, dining, food delivery, shopping and utility bill spends, capped at ₹1,200 cashback a month. Other eligible domestic retail spends earn unlimited 1.5% cashback.

faqs.question: Does the HSBC Live+ Credit Card offer 10% cashback on Amazon and Flipkart?
faqs.answer: Regular shopping purchases on Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra are not eligible for 10% cashback. However, eligible grocery transactions, such as Amazon Fresh or grocery orders classified under the Grocery merchant category, can still earn 10% cashback depending on the merchant category code (MCC).

faqs.question: Does the HSBC Live+ Credit Card earn cashback on international transactions?
faqs.answer: No. From 26 July 2026, international transactions no longer earn cashback. However, the forex markup has been reduced to 1.99%, making the card more cost-effective for overseas spending.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the HSBC Live+ Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The HSBC Live+ Credit Card has a joining fee and annual fee of ₹999 + GST. The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹2 lakh or more in a membership year.

program_updates_2026: 2026 Updates: Forex reduced to 1.99%, includes 1 complimentary international + 2 domestic lounges/yr, ₹1,200/mo 10% cap covers Amazon Fresh & Flipkart Minutes Grocery MCCs.

While the HSBC Live+ Credit Card is primarily a cashback card, it also offers complimentary airport lounge access. Following the July 2026 revision, the lounge benefit has been scaled back, making it more suitable for occasional travellers than frequent flyers.

The HSBC Live+ Credit Card has changed considerably over the years, but its core proposition remains the same – it rewards the expenses that most households incur every month. The July 2026 changes have reduced its appeal for frequent travellers by cutting lounge access and removing cashback on international spends, but they haven’t taken away what makes the card valuable.
